Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, do not hold me accountable in it for my stumbles
And forgive me in it for my sins and mistakes

Arabic text: وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْهِ غَرَضًا لِلْبَلايَا وَالْآفَاتِ
Translation: And do not make me in it a target for afflictions and calamities
By Your honor, O Honor of the Muslims
